messages:
maria: Opened PR #2484 with the migration guide + Python SDK snippet. CI is failing on docs-ci (linkcheck) and vale. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2484

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck failed — 1 broken link

sam: @kevin @luca can one of you review? we'd like to get this merged before the release freeze at 17:00 PT.

kevin: I can do a quick pass in ~30m. linkcheck 404s are usually fast to fix.

maria: Linkcheck output: `404 https://old-repo.example.com/sdk/python -> docs/sdk/python.md`
Vale output: PassiveVoice in migration-guide.md: "It is recommended to ..." line ~78

ci-bot: vale lint: 2 errors (PassiveVoice in migration-guide.md: line 78, PassiveVoice in sdk-snippet.md: line 22)
markdownlint: no errors

luca: For the 404 we should update the link to the new canonical path (/sdk/python/) or use the internal redirect. I can push a one-line fix. For Vale, either reword or tweak .vale.ini; prefer rewording if it's small.

maria: prefer rewording too (less config churn). But if we can't get this in before freeze, what's our policy on bypassing linkcheck?

jonathan: Policy recap: we don't bypass linkcheck on main unless it's a known redirect that doc-preview shows working. Docs lead sign-off required to merge with failing checks. @sam any objections?

sam: OK to approve once kevin + docs lead sign off. If we can't finish before freeze, queue for tomorrow morning. Do not override linkcheck by default.

kevin: Reviewed the PR. Small nits commented inline. LGT M after the link change and the Vale phrasing fix. I'll wait for the commit then re-run checks.

maria: pushed fixes: swapped the dead URL to /sdk/python/ and rephrased the line to active voice. Local check: `npx vale .` passes. Commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2484/commits/3f9a

ci-bot: Re-run completed — all checks passed ✅
Docs preview deployed: https://deployments.docs.redwood.com/pr-2484

sam: Merging now so it lands before freeze. Thanks everyone :tada:

maria: merged — thanks team :heart:
